claim: Source-reported efficiencies can be compared only after matching their input/output boundaries and acquisition conditions.
status: reviewed: operating conditions and denominators must match
objection: A receiver-only efficiency or capacitor discharge can look like an overall energy source.
response: POWER reports >800 W at 8.6 km during a 30-second transmission, while >20% optical-to-receiver-electrical efficiency belongs to shorter-distance tests. These are different conditions; neither is laser wall-plug efficiency. The Tesla patent and powered gain circuit require external inputs and storage accounting.
decision: Adopt for every displayed energy ratio.
nextMissingMeasurement: Synchronized, calibrated same-run external input/output, controller power and storage endpoints, with uncertainty.
physicalValidation: No hardware measurements or independent physical replications performed in this project.

claim: MARRS BAA page 4 contains inconsistent picobarn-to-cm² notation.
objection: OCR corruption or a different source version could explain the apparent mismatch.
response: Records visually checked official PDF page 4; the systems reviewer separately inspected that image and BIPM Tables 7/8, and used exact decimal arithmetic. 1 pb = 10^-40 m² = 10^-36 cm²; the printed 10^-12 cm² parenthesis differs by 10^24. Review reused the preserved official PDF bytes rather than independently downloading a second copy.
decision: Retain the literal source, page and SHA256; exclude the inconsistent parenthesis from all physical model inputs. Do not guess its intended cross section or infer reactor/program performance.
nextMissingMeasurement: An agency correction or clarification of the intended value; no further measurement is needed for the stated SI conversion.
physicalValidation: No hardware measurements or independent physical replications performed in this project.
verdict: resolved unit conversion; agency correction and intended value unresolved

claim: A Hamiltonian-norm cost metric is not measured apparatus electricity consumption.
status: reviewed: energy-dimensional proxy, not measured work
objection: A quantum paper cost ratio could be ranked against optical or acoustic hardware efficiency.
response: For Sigma=(1/tau) integral ||H_d(t)|| dt, H_d in joules makes Sigma energy-dimensional. The definition is a time-averaged drive-Hamiltonian norm, not a calorimetric or wall-plug energy transfer. The two quantities must not be equated merely because their units match.
decision: Keep the paper-defined proxy and extraction ratio separate from apparatus conversion efficiency; do not call it dimensionally invalid. Missing preparation, control, refrigeration, readout and reset costs stay unmeasured.
nextMissingMeasurement: Calibrated preparation, drive, bath, readout and reset transfers on a common complete cycle and boundary.
physicalValidation: No hardware measurements or independent physical replications performed in this project.

claim: A brute-force parameter search can test a declared model but cannot resolve an unidentifiable inverse problem by increasing sample count.
status: reviewed: exact ambiguity outranks additional search samples
objection: A good fit might be presented as finding a hidden source.
response: The systems panel derives the exact invariant Ze+g²/Zm under (m,b,k,g) -> (a m,a b,a k,sqrt(a) g). Metrology separately gives a rank-one residual model with two null directions. More samples of the same ambiguous observables cannot identify a unique cause. These are local project derivations; listed papers provide methodological context, not the exact project equations.
decision: Use the analytic invariance and kernel witnesses as the central evidence. Numerical ranks and bounded grids are corroboration under stated inputs, not universal proofs or hardware discoveries.
nextMissingMeasurement: An independently calibrated observable that changes across the ambiguity, such as mechanical velocity in the stated converter model.
physicalValidation: No hardware measurements or independent physical replications performed in this project.

claim: Local resonant pressure or open-circuit voltage gain does not establish additional net energy.
status: reviewed: source and model conditions retained
objection: Peak pressure, absorption and electrical output can occur under different conditions or use different amplitude conventions.
response: The 2023 source has RMS wording alongside a factor 1/2, so the model states its own peak convention explicitly. The later abstract/index-only records cannot supply an audited common-condition budget. Plane-wave flux through a chosen aperture is a conditional reference, not a universal capture-area bound.
decision: Use loading-aware power conversion and one outer energy ledger; do not double-count speaker electricity and the internal sound transfer.
nextMissingMeasurement: Calibrated pressure-velocity flux or validated wave decomposition, loaded electrical power, source input and storage change acquired under the same conditions.
physicalValidation: No acoustic hardware replication was performed.
